summary: We developed Matelom, which is an interactive presentation about the leftover equipment left alone. This project is made so people of all ages can learn about the problem of leftover hardware. This project uses images and creative interactive elements to bring it to life
details:
Our project, Matelom, aims to create a quick and easy way to tell the story of the forgotten equipment we have left on the Moon and Mars. On the other hand, our group aims to raise concern for removing the habit of leaving unwanted stuff anywhere.

AI tools:

  • Chatgpt
  • Gemini
  • Netlify(Claude)
